name: browser
description: Drive a real browser by writing Playwright: read the page as a small accessibility outline, act with real Playwright calls, and see only what changed.
whenToUse: Before any browser_use call, and whenever you need to look at a page. Load this to get the observation loop, the view()/viewChanges() primitives, and the locator idioms right so a browsing task does not burn context re-reading the same page.
author: Reaper
